integrity: Finite anchored Gram characteristic polynomials and explicit obstruction vectors use exact integer arithmetic; the universal obstruction is proved using the infinite two-layer cover and a uniform winding bound. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns only the exponent-one shortest-path Gaussian kernel on GP(n,2) for integers n>=5; optimal fractional negative-type exponents and individual-scale positivity for excluded orders are not determined. An older equivalent result may remain unidentified.
title: Gaussian positivity on the generalized Petersen graphs \(GP(n,2)\): exactly four surviving orders
